name: MCP_CREO_MechDog

drawing.scope: native DRW sheets, general/projected views, driving dimensions, notes, tables, edits, deletion and PDF
drawing.limits: owned part/sheetmetal snapshots; no live source update, assembly drawings, sections, detail views, GD&T or automatic BOM

datums.scope: coordinate systems and dimensioned point arrays in addition to planes and axes
datums.native_test: XYZ offsets 10/20/30, Z rotation 45 degrees, native origin check and offset dimension edit

surface_solid.native_test: 20 x 10 fill, symmetric thickness 2 to 3; plane cut of a cube
surface_solid.limits: closed-quilt solidification, curved-quilt offset/cut and all side options need further validation

boolean_bodies.native_test: overlapping cubes: union 1500, difference 500 and intersection 500 mm3
boolean_bodies.limits: multi-target/tool lists and keep_tools require further native validation

rib.scope: native profile rib driven by an open sketch
rib.limits: sketch must intersect the solid; material side depends on sketch direction; trajectory ribs are not wrapped

udf.scope: local UDF metadata and independent native feature-group placement with reference/variable-dimension mapping
udf.limits: part/sheetmetal only; exact reference prompts required; assembly UDFs, quadrants, variable parameters and manufacturing UDFs are not wrapped; libraries supplied by user

mirror.native_test: whole solid about a principal datum plane
mirror.limits: whole-part/geometry references only; feature/subtree mirror is rejected

sweep.native_test: straight trajectory, circular constant section, named diameter edit
sweep.limits: constant section; other trajectories, thin/cut/surface branches need installation-specific validation

draft.native_test: constant unsplit draft on a planar face with a planar neutral reference
draft.limits: variable, split and rib draft are not high-level tools

loft.reason: Native blend/loft creation has not passed Creo 10 regeneration and saved-file verification.

sheetmetal.scope: first flat wall, attached flange, unbend, bend-back and flat pattern
sheetmetal.native_test: 40 x 30 x 1 wall, 90 degree flange with R2/R3 bend, followed by unfolding and refolding
sheetmetal.limits: first wall uses thin extrusion then native conversion; bend relief, forms, hems and jogs are not high-level tools

assembly.native_test: part snapshots, rigid placement, removal, 3 datum-plane align constraints and 20 mm offset
assembly.limits: MCP-owned part/sheetmetal sources; no nested assemblies; source edits do not update snapshots; mate/insert/csys/default placement need further validation

unavailable_operations.loft: Native blend/loft creation has not passed Creo 10 regeneration and saved-file verification.

historical_evidence: validation_0.21.json; old release tests excluded from development counts
baseline_regression_scope: Development tests also exercise sketch, extrusion, dimensions, regeneration and checkpoint rollback. Full 0.21 integration suites were not rerun for this development build.
evidence_type: Development-machine native tests; not verification of another installation
validation_note: The release label is 0.22. Native modeling evidence retains its original development version and applies to byte-identical modeling runtime. Input validation and MCP version/connection checks were rerun for 0.22.
